title: Northwestern Tunisia
description: Datasets registered under the 'Northwestern Tunisia' Living Landscape (11 item(s)). Spatial extent derives from the canonical landscape delineation (2026-07-21); the simplified boundary is published as this collection's 'boundary' asset. National-coverage member items can widen the extent beyond the boundary.
mosaic:bbox_note: Bbox derived from the canonical delineation shapefile (dissolved, EPSG:4326), union-ed with member-item locator boxes.

boundary.title: Landscape boundary (canonical delineation, simplified, EPSG:4326)
boundary.mosaic:source: Tunisia - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB) v01, admin level 4, valid 2022-11-15; source Institut National de la Statistique Tunisie (INS), published by OCHA on HDX. Union of 7 sectors: Bousliaa, El Marja and Elles (Es Sers, Le Kef); El Ahouez Sud (Gaafour), Hammam Biadha Sud (El Krib), Chouarnia (Makthar) and Kesra (Kesra) (Siliana).
boundary.mosaic:attribution: Contains data from 'Tunisia - Subnational Administrative Boundaries' (COD-AB), source: Institut National de la Statistique Tunisie (INS), published by UN OCHA on the Humanitarian Data Exchange (https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-tun), licensed under CC BY-IGO 3.0. Changes: seven admin-4 sectors dissolved into one outline and simplified.
